ayahs.arabic: قٓۚ وَٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ ٱلۡمَجِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Qaf waalqurani almajeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Qaf. By the honored Qur'an

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ عَجِبُوٓاْ أَن جَآءَهُم مُّنذِرࣱ مِّنۡهُمۡ فَقَالَ ٱلۡكَٰفِرُونَ هَٰذَا شَيۡءٌ عَجِيبٌ
ayahs.translit: Bal AAajiboo an jaahum munthirun minhum faqala alkafiroona hatha shayon AAajeebun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they wonder that there has come to them a warner from among themselves, and the disbelievers say, "This is an amazing thing

ayahs.arabic: أَءِذَا مِتۡنَا وَكُنَّا تُرَابࣰ اۖ ذَٰلِكَ رَجۡعُۢ بَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Aitha mitna wakunna turaban thalika rajAAun baAAeedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When we have died and have become dust, [we will return to life]? That is a distant return

ayahs.arabic: قَدۡ عَلِمۡنَا مَا تَنقُصُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ مِنۡهُمۡۖ وَعِندَنَا كِتَٰبٌ حَفِيظُۢ
ayahs.translit: Qad AAalimna ma tanqusu alardu minhum waAAindana kitabun hafeethun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We know what the earth diminishes of them, and with Us is a retaining record

ayahs.arabic: بَلۡ كَذَّبُواْ بِٱلۡحَقِّ لَمَّا جَآءَهُمۡ فَهُمۡ فِيٓ أَمۡرࣲ مَّرِيجٍ
ayahs.translit: Bal kaththaboo bialhaqqi lamma jaahum fahum fee amrin mareejin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: But they denied the truth when it came to them, so they are in a confused condition

ayahs.arabic: أَفَلَمۡ يَنظُرُوٓاْ إِلَى ٱلسَّمَآءِ فَوۡقَهُمۡ كَيۡفَ بَنَيۡنَٰهَا وَزَيَّنَّٰهَا وَمَا لَهَا مِن فُرُوجࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Afalam yanthuroo ila alssamai fawqahum kayfa banaynaha wazayyannaha wama laha min furoojin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Have they not looked at the heaven above them - how We structured it and adorned it and [how] it has no rifts

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ مَدَدۡنَٰهَا وَأَلۡقَيۡنَا فِيهَا رَوَٰسِيَ وَأَنۢبَتۡنَا فِيهَا مِن كُلِّ زَوۡجِۭ بَهِيجࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Waalarda madadnaha waalqayna feeha rawasiya waanbatna feeha min kulli zawjin baheejin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the earth - We spread it out and cast therein firmly set mountains and made grow therein [something] of every beautiful kind

ayahs.arabic: تَبۡصِرَةࣰ وَذِكۡرَىٰ لِكُلِّ عَبۡدࣲ مُّنِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Tabsiratan wathikra likulli AAabdin muneebin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Giving insight and a reminder for every servant who turns [to Allah]

ayahs.arabic: وَنَزَّلۡنَا مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءࣰ مُّبَٰرَكࣰ ا فَأَنۢبَتۡنَا بِهِۦ جَنَّٰتࣲ وَحَبَّ ٱلۡحَصِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Wanazzalna mina alssamai maan mubarakan faanbatna bihi jannatin wahabba alhaseedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have sent down blessed rain from the sky and made grow thereby gardens and grain from the harvest

ayahs.arabic: وَٱلنَّخۡلَ بَاسِقَٰتࣲ لَّهَا طَلۡعࣱ نَّضِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Waalnnakhla basiqatin laha talAAun nadeedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And lofty palm trees having fruit arranged in layers

ayahs.arabic: رِّزۡقࣰ ا لِّلۡعِبَادِۖ وَأَحۡيَيۡنَا بِهِۦ بَلۡدَةࣰ مَّيۡتࣰ اۚ كَذَٰلِكَ ٱلۡخُرُوجُ
ayahs.translit: Rizqan lilAAibadi waahyayna bihi baldatan maytan kathalika alkhurooju

t.eng-ummmuhammad: As provision for the servants, and We have given life thereby to a dead land. Thus is the resurrection

ayahs.arabic: كَذَّبَتۡ قَبۡلَهُمۡ قَوۡمُ نُوحࣲ وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلرَّسِّ وَثَمُودُ
ayahs.translit: Kaththabat qablahum qawmu noohin waashabu alrrassi wathamoodu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The people of Noah denied before them, and the companions of the well and Thamud

ayahs.arabic: وَعَادࣱ وَفِرۡعَوۡنُ وَإِخۡوَٰنُ لُوطࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: WaAAadun wafirAAawnu waikhwanu lootin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And 'Aad and Pharaoh and the brothers of Lot

ayahs.arabic: وَأَصۡحَٰبُ ٱلۡأَيۡكَةِ وَقَوۡمُ تُبَّعࣲۚ كُلࣱّ كَذَّبَ ٱلرُّسُلَ فَحَقَّ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Waashabu alaykati waqawmu tubbaAAin kullun kaththaba alrrusula fahaqqa waAAeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the companions of the thicket and the people of Tubba'. All denied the messengers, so My threat was justly fulfilled

ayahs.arabic: أَفَعَيِينَا بِٱلۡخَلۡقِ ٱلۡأَوَّلِۚ بَلۡ هُمۡ فِي لَبۡسࣲ مِّنۡ خَلۡقࣲ جَدِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: AfaAAayeena bialkhalqi alawwali bal hum fee labsin min khalqin jadeedin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Did We fail in the first creation? But they are in confusion over a new creation

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلۡإِنسَٰنَ وَنَعۡلَمُ مَا تُوَسۡوِسُ بِهِۦ نَفۡسُهُۥۖ وَنَحۡنُ أَقۡرَبُ إِلَيۡهِ مِنۡ حَبۡلِ ٱلۡوَرِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Walaqad khalaqna alinsana wanaAAlamu ma tuwaswisu bihi nafsuhu wanahnu aqrabu ilayhi min habli alwareedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We have already created man and know what his soul whispers to him, and We are closer to him than [his] jugular vein

ayahs.arabic: إِذۡ يَتَلَقَّى ٱلۡمُتَلَقِّيَانِ عَنِ ٱلۡيَمِينِ وَعَنِ ٱلشِّمَالِ قَعِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Ith yatalaqqa almutalaqqiyani AAani alyameeni waAAani alshshimali qaAAeedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: When the two receivers receive, seated on the right and on the left

ayahs.arabic: مَّا يَلۡفِظُ مِن قَوۡلٍ إِلَّا لَدَيۡهِ رَقِيبٌ عَتِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Ma yalfithu min qawlin illa ladayhi raqeebun AAateedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Man does not utter any word except that with him is an observer prepared [to record]

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَتۡ سَكۡرَةُ ٱلۡمَوۡتِ بِٱلۡحَقِّۖ ذَٰلِكَ مَا كُنتَ مِنۡهُ تَحِيدُ
ayahs.translit: Wajaat sakratu almawti bialhaqqi thalika ma kunta minhu taheedu

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the intoxication of death will bring the truth; that is what you were trying to avoid

ayahs.arabic: وَنُفِخَ فِي ٱلصُّورِۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Wanufikha fee alssoori thalika yawmu alwaAAeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And the Horn will be blown. That is the Day of [carrying out] the threat

ayahs.arabic: وَجَآءَتۡ كُلُّ نَفۡسࣲ مَّعَهَا سَآئِقࣱ وَشَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Wajaat kullu nafsin maAAaha saiqun washaheedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And every soul will come, with it a driver and a witness

ayahs.arabic: لَّقَدۡ كُنتَ فِي غَفۡلَةࣲ مِّنۡ هَٰذَا فَكَشَفۡنَا عَنكَ غِطَآءَكَ فَبَصَرُكَ ٱلۡيَوۡمَ حَدِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Laqad kunta fee ghaflatin min hatha fakashafna AAanka ghitaaka fabasaruka alyawma hadeedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It will be said], "You were certainly in unmindfulness of this, and We have removed from you your cover, so your sight, this Day, is sharp

ayahs.arabic: وَقَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ هَٰذَا مَا لَدَيَّ عَتِيدٌ
ayahs.translit: Waqala qareenuhu hatha ma ladayya AAateedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And his companion, [the angel], will say, "This [record] is what is with me, prepared

ayahs.arabic: أَلۡقِيَا فِي جَهَنَّمَ كُلَّ كَفَّارٍ عَنِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Alqiya fee jahannama kulla kaffarin AAaneedin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah will say], "Throw into Hell every obstinate disbeliever

ayahs.arabic: مَّنَّاعࣲ لِّلۡخَيۡرِ مُعۡتَدࣲ مُّرِيبٍ
ayahs.translit: MannaAAin lilkhayri muAAtadin mureebin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Preventer of good, aggressor, and doubter

ayahs.arabic: ٱلَّذِي جَعَلَ مَعَ ٱللَّهِ إِلَٰهًا ءَاخَرَ فَأَلۡقِيَاهُ فِي ٱلۡعَذَابِ ٱلشَّدِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Allathee jaAAala maAAa Allahi ilahan akhara faalqiyahu fee alAAathabi alshshadeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who made [as equal] with Allah another deity; then throw him into the severe punishment

ayahs.arabic: ۞قَالَ قَرِينُهُۥ رَبَّنَا مَآ أَطۡغَيۡتُهُۥ وَلَٰكِن كَانَ فِي ضَلَٰلِۭ بَعِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Qala qareenuhu rabbana ma atghaytuhu walakin kana fee dalalin baAAeedin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: His [devil] companion will say, "Our Lord, I did not make him transgress, but he [himself] was in extreme error

ayahs.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخۡتَصِمُواْ لَدَيَّ وَقَدۡ قَدَّمۡتُ إِلَيۡكُم بِٱلۡوَعِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Qala la takhtasimoo ladayya waqad qaddamtu ilaykum bialwaAAeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [Allah] will say, "Do not dispute before Me, while I had already presented to you the warning

ayahs.arabic: مَا يُبَدَّلُ ٱلۡقَوۡلُ لَدَيَّ وَمَآ أَنَا۠ بِظَلَّٰمࣲ لِّلۡعَبِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Ma yubaddalu alqawlu ladayya wama ana bithallamin lilAAabeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The word will not be changed with Me, and never will I be unjust to the servants

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ نَقُولُ لِجَهَنَّمَ هَلِ ٱمۡتَلَأۡتِ وَتَقُولُ هَلۡ مِن مَّزِيدࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Yawma naqoolu lijahannama hali imtalati wataqoolu hal min mazeedin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On the Day We will say to Hell, "Have you been filled?" and it will say, "Are there some more

ayahs.arabic: وَأُزۡلِفَتِ ٱلۡجَنَّةُ لِلۡمُتَّقِينَ غَيۡرَ بَعِيدٍ
ayahs.translit: Waozlifati aljannatu lilmuttaqeena ghayra baAAeedin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And Paradise will be brought near to the righteous, not far

ayahs.arabic: هَٰذَا مَا تُوعَدُونَ لِكُلِّ أَوَّابٍ حَفِيظࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Hatha ma tooAAadoona likulli awwabin hafeethin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: [It will be said], "This is what you were promised - for every returner [to Allah] and keeper [of His covenant]

ayahs.arabic: مَّنۡ خَشِيَ ٱلرَّحۡمَٰنَ بِٱلۡغَيۡبِ وَجَآءَ بِقَلۡبࣲ مُّنِيبٍ
ayahs.translit: Man khashiya alrrahmana bialghaybi wajaa biqalbin muneebin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Who feared the Most Merciful unseen and came with a heart returning [in repentance]

ayahs.arabic: ٱدۡخُلُوهَا بِسَلَٰمࣲۖ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُلُودِ
ayahs.translit: Odkhulooha bisalamin thalika yawmu alkhuloodi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Enter it in peace. This is the Day of Eternity

ayahs.arabic: لَهُم مَّا يَشَآءُونَ فِيهَا وَلَدَيۡنَا مَزِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Lahum ma yashaoona feeha waladayna mazeedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: They will have whatever they wish therein, and with Us is more

ayahs.arabic: وَكَمۡ أَهۡلَكۡنَا قَبۡلَهُم مِّن قَرۡنٍ هُمۡ أَشَدُّ مِنۡهُم بَطۡشࣰ ا فَنَقَّبُواْ فِي ٱلۡبِلَٰدِ هَلۡ مِن مَّحِيصٍ
ayahs.translit: Wakam ahlakna qablahum min qarnin hum ashaddu minhum batshan fanaqqaboo fee albiladi hal min maheesin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And how many a generation before them did We destroy who were greater than them in [striking] power and had explored throughout the lands. Is there any place of escape

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّ فِي ذَٰلِكَ لَذِكۡرَىٰ لِمَن كَانَ لَهُۥ قَلۡبٌ أَوۡ أَلۡقَى ٱلسَّمۡعَ وَهُوَ شَهِيدࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Inna fee thalika lathikra liman kana lahu qalbun aw alqa alssamAAa wahuwa shaheedun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed in that is a reminder for whoever has a heart or who listens while he is present [in mind]

ayahs.arabic: وَلَقَدۡ خَلَقۡنَا ٱلسَّمَٰوَٰتِ وَٱلۡأَرۡضَ وَمَا بَيۡنَهُمَا فِي سِتَّةِ أَيَّامࣲ وَمَا مَسَّنَا مِن لُّغُوبࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: Walaqad khalaqna alssamawati waalarda wama baynahuma fee sittati ayyamin wama massana min lughoobin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And We did certainly create the heavens and earth and what is between them in six days, and there touched Us no weariness

ayahs.arabic: فَٱصۡبِرۡ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحۡ بِحَمۡدِ رَبِّكَ قَبۡلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمۡسِ وَقَبۡلَ ٱلۡغُرُوبِ
ayahs.translit: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla alghuroobi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: So be patient, [O Muhammad], over what they say and exalt [Allah] with praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before its setting

ayahs.arabic: وَمِنَ ٱلَّيۡلِ فَسَبِّحۡهُ وَأَدۡبَٰرَ ٱلسُّجُودِ
ayahs.translit: Wamina allayli fasabbihhu waadbara alssujoodi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And [in part] of the night exalt Him and after prostration

ayahs.arabic: وَٱسۡتَمِعۡ يَوۡمَ يُنَادِ ٱلۡمُنَادِ مِن مَّكَانࣲ قَرِيبࣲ‏
ayahs.translit: WaistamiAA yawma yunadi almunadi min makanin qareebin

t.eng-ummmuhammad: And listen on the Day when the Caller will call out from a place that is near

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ يَسۡمَعُونَ ٱلصَّيۡحَةَ بِٱلۡحَقِّۚ ذَٰلِكَ يَوۡمُ ٱلۡخُرُوجِ
ayahs.translit: Yawma yasmaAAoona alssayhata bialhaqqi thalika yawmu alkhurooji

t.eng-ummmuhammad: The Day they will hear the blast [of the Horn] in truth. That is the Day of Emergence [from the graves]

ayahs.arabic: إِنَّا نَحۡنُ نُحۡيِۦ وَنُمِيتُ وَإِلَيۡنَا ٱلۡمَصِيرُ
ayahs.translit: Inna nahnu nuhyee wanumeetu wailayna almaseeru

t.eng-ummmuhammad: Indeed, it is We who give life and cause death, and to Us is the destination

ayahs.arabic: يَوۡمَ تَشَقَّقُ ٱلۡأَرۡضُ عَنۡهُمۡ سِرَاعࣰ اۚ ذَٰلِكَ حَشۡرٌ عَلَيۡنَا يَسِيرࣱ‏
ayahs.translit: Yawma tashaqqaqu alardu AAanhum siraAAan thalika hashrun AAalayna yaseerun

t.eng-ummmuhammad: On the Day the earth breaks away from them [and they emerge] rapidly; that is a gathering easy for Us

ayahs.arabic: نَّحۡنُ أَعۡلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَۖ وَمَآ أَنتَ عَلَيۡهِم بِجَبَّارࣲۖ فَذَكِّرۡ بِٱلۡقُرۡءَانِ مَن يَخَافُ وَعِيدِ
ayahs.translit: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona wama anta AAalayhim bijabbarin fathakkir bialqurani man yakhafu waAAeedi

t.eng-ummmuhammad: We are most knowing of what they say, and you are not over them a tyrant. But remind by the Qur'an whoever fears My threat
